intended_object: The class of open immersions of schemes, viewed as a morphism property on the category of schemes (in universe u). Inferred from the docstring and name.
explanation: The definition is literally `@IsOpenImmersion`, Mathlib's open-immersion class, read as a `MorphismProperty Scheme.{u}`. Its only purpose is to fix the universe so that it can be passed as the argument `P` to constructions like `Scheme.smallGrothendieckTopology` and `Scheme.overGrothendieckTopology`. Mathematically it is the property of being an open immersion, which is exactly what the docstring says. It is stated for schemes in an arbitrary universe `u`, which is the natural generality, so it is neither wrong nor too narrow.
